arguments.name: stationCode
arguments.description:
When the user provides a station code, this performs an exact match search.
Triggers the Search action with criteria = STATION_CODE and returns the matching station record. (e.g., "000004")

raw.name: stationCode
raw.description:
When the user provides a station code, this performs an exact match search.
Triggers the Search action with criteria = STATION_CODE and returns the matching station record. (e.g., "000004")

arguments.name: stationName
arguments.description:
When the user provides a station name (full or partial), this performs a case-insensitive partial match search.
Triggers the Search action with criteria = STATION_NAME and returns all matching station rows. (e.g., "Kandy")

raw.name: stationName
raw.description:
When the user provides a station name (full or partial), this performs a case-insensitive partial match search.
Triggers the Search action with criteria = STATION_NAME and returns all matching station rows. (e.g., "Kandy")

arguments.name: transportCost
arguments.description:
When the user provides a transport cost value, this performs an exact match search on the station transport cost.
Triggers the Search action with criteria = STATION_COST and returns stations with that cost. (e.g., "150.00")

raw.name: transportCost
raw.description:
When the user provides a transport cost value, this performs an exact match search on the station transport cost.
Triggers the Search action with criteria = STATION_COST and returns stations with that cost. (e.g., "150.00")

arguments.name: routeName
arguments.description:
When the user provides a route name, this performs a partial match search against the route group headers.
Returns all stations listed under routes that match the provided route name. (e.g., "Central Expressway")

raw.name: routeName
raw.description:
When the user provides a route name, this performs a partial match search against the route group headers.
Returns all stations listed under routes that match the provided route name. (e.g., "Central Expressway")

arguments.name: returnAll
arguments.description:
When user asks to return all/available/existing stations, set this to one of:
"true", "yes", "all", "1", "showall", "returnall", "available", "existing", "list"
Triggers Show All and returns every station row from the grid.

raw.name: returnAll
raw.description:
When user asks to return all/available/existing stations, set this to one of:
"true", "yes", "all", "1", "showall", "returnall", "available", "existing", "list"
Triggers Show All and returns every station row from the grid.

arguments.name: autoFetchAllPages
arguments.description:
Controls paging when returnAll is used.
"true" → auto-loop pages and return everything (default when returnAll is truthy)
"false" → return only the requested/current page and include moreAvailable + nextPage Example: "false"

raw.name: autoFetchAllPages
raw.description:
Controls paging when returnAll is used.
"true" → auto-loop pages and return everything (default when returnAll is truthy)
"false" → return only the requested/current page and include moreAvailable + nextPage Example: "false"

arguments.name: pageNumber
arguments.description:
Page number to fetch (used when autoFetchAllPages is "false"). Default: "1"
Example: "2"

raw.name: pageNumber
raw.description:
Page number to fetch (used when autoFetchAllPages is "false"). Default: "1"
Example: "2"

arguments.name: pageSize
arguments.description:
Page size sent to the grid pager (server may cap). Default: "100"
Example: "50"

raw.name: pageSize
raw.description:
Page size sent to the grid pager (server may cap). Default: "100"
Example: "50"

arguments.name: maxPages
arguments.description:
Safety limit for page looping to avoid infinite loops. Default: "50"
Example: "10"

raw.name: maxPages
raw.description:
Safety limit for page looping to avoid infinite loops. Default: "50"
Example: "10"
